title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: DYNASTY CENTER
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: DYNASTY CENTER

  CHC-2026-4813-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-4814-CE  Council District: 1 – Hernandez
  Plan Area: Downtown  Last Day to Act: 10-16-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS: 800-816 North Broadway; 225-233 West Alpine Street;
  815-821 North Spring Street

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  Review of the Historic-Cultural Monument application, pursuant to Los Angeles Administrative Code
  Section 22.171.10, to determine whether to take the proposed designation of a Monument under
  consideration.

  Owners:  Redcar CT9 Owner, LLC; De Young and Hyon K. Kim

  Applicants:  Calvin Nguyen and Huy Pham, Asian & Pacific Islander Americans in Historic
  Preservation
summary: Cultural Heritage Commission review of an application to designate the Dynasty Center at 800 North Broadway in Downtown as a Historic-Cultural Monument.
